pages.excerpt:
The**minister for European affairs**([Italian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_language):*ministro per gli affari Europei*) in[Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italy)is one of the positions in the[Italian government](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cabinet_of_Italy), head of the Department for European Policies.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minister_for_European_Affairs_(Italy)#cite_note-1)

The current minister for European affairs is[Tommaso Foti](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tommaso_Foti), of the[Brothers of Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brothers_of_Italy)party, who is serving since 2 December 2024.
